ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dark-grey/black base dominates approximately 85% of the surface area, contrasted by high-intensity white pixel clusters accounting for approximately 15% of the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey background with high-contrast white annular (ring-shaped) and circular blobs ranging from 5 to 50 pixels in diameter distributed non-uniformly across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-15 pixels creating a jagged profile along the entire trailing boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch, tapering into slightly concave distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular and semi-circular pixel clusters (barnacle attachment scars) distributed across the entirety of both lobes, with higher concentration on the lower medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the medial portion of the right lobe and the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified barnacle clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating a textured, irregular protrusion from the fluke's organic boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white calcification and biological growth at the extreme trailing edge tips, altering the standard geometric taper of the fluke lobes.
